book.soulland.page.alchemy:
7. ALCHEMY STATION

Craft an Alchemy Station from two Spirit Iron Ingots, a Soul Crystal Shard and a Soul Essence, then right click it to open the brewing screen.
Cultivation Pill: Spirit Dew, Spirit Ember, 1 Soul Essence.
Swift Pill: Spirit Moss, Spirit Dew, 1 Soul Essence.
Foundation Pill: Spirit Ember, Spirit Moss, 2 Soul Essence.
book.soulland.page.beasts:
6. SOUL BEAST AND BOSSES

Monsters are soul beasts. Their name carries their age and element, so you always know what you are hunting.
Bosses of this world are far stronger than vanilla: Elder Guardian, Wither, Warden, and the ENDER DRAGON as the final boss.
book.soulland.page.closing:
KEEP CULTIVATING

"No martial soul is rubbish; only rubbish spirit masters are." - Grandmaster Yu Xiaogang

Train, hunt as a team and never give up. The road to God starts at level 1.
book.soulland.page.commands:
8. COMMANDS

/soulinfo - your cultivation status
/soul language - open the language screen
/martialsoul info - details about your martial soul
/martialsoul reroll - replace your martial soul (Creative only)
/sect choose <name> - join a sect
/cultivation set <player> <level> - admin
book.soulland.page.foundation:
4. FOUNDATION

Meditation builds your foundation from 0 to 100. The foundation sets your breakthrough chance: at 20 you may attempt the ceremony, at 100 the breakthrough always succeeds.
A failed ceremony costs 25 foundation points, so meditate again before you try once more.

The Foundation Pill adds 25 points at once. Reach level %s and the god gate opens: the sky thunders over you.
book.soulland.page.level:
2. SPIRIT POWER LEVEL

Levels run from 1 to 120. Kill soul beasts (monsters) to gain cultivation XP.
Every rank boundary is a gate: you cannot pass it without absorbing a new spirit ring, holding a full meditation and spending one Soul Essence.
book.soulland.page.martial_soul:
1. MARTIAL SOUL (WU HUN)

The first time you join the world you pick the language, then the Awakening Ceremony opens. You choose your martial soul yourself; there is no draw, no lottery.
That choice is yours for life, and only Creative mode can replace it with /martialsoul reroll.
book.soulland.page.multiplayer:
9. MULTIPLAYER

Every system runs on the server: ceremony, levels, rings, skills and alchemy are saved per player.
Invite friends, build a team (the Pagoda support soul helps a lot) and take the bosses down together.
book.soulland.page.ranks.goal:
THE FINAL GOAL

The ladder ends at God, starting from level %s. Reaching it raises the tribulation flag: the sky thunders and lightning strikes. The full tribulation system arrives in v1.6, so v1.2B only marks the threshold.

Absorb the gold 1,000,000 year ring, defeat the Ender Dragon, and your name becomes legend on the Douluo Continent.
book.soulland.page.ranks.note: Every rank boundary is a gate: absorb a new spirit ring and meditate fully before you climb.
book.soulland.page.ranks.title: CULTIVATION RANK LADDER
book.soulland.page.rings:
3. SPIRIT RING

Soul beasts drop rings according to their age: 100 years, 1,000 years, 10,000 years, 100,000 years and the gold tier of 1,000,000 years.
The gold tier falls from the Ender Dragon and sometimes from the Warden.

RISK: every ring has a safe level. Absorbing above it is dangerous: the server rolls your chance to fail, and a failure destroys the ring and hits you with backlash. Hold Shift to confirm a risky absorption.

MUTATION: every successful absorption has a 1% chance to mutate the ring. Its effective age rises one grade and your permanent stat bonus grows.
book.soulland.page.skills:
5. MARTIAL SOUL SKILLS

Every martial soul has 4 skills. They open at spirit ring 1, 3, 5 and 7.
Skills cost spirit power (the blue bar in the HUD) and have their own cooldown.
Press R, G, F and V to use them, or open the Soul Card with J to rearrange the loadout.
book.soulland.page.welcome:
WELCOME TO THE DOULUO CONTINENT

You have awakened your Martial Soul! This book explains every system of the Soul Land world: cultivation, spirit rings, skills, soul beasts, alchemy and the road to God.

Read it once, then keep it in your inventory. Every page follows the language you chose.
book.soulland.title: Soul Land Guide
guide.soulland.section.1:
1. Hunt soul beasts. The name carries the age and the element, for example "1,000 Years (Fire)" or "10,000 Years (Ice)".
2. Absorb the spirit rings they drop.
3. Rebuild your loadout in the Soul Card (J), tab SKILLS. Five slots, any order.
4. Chain skills to raise damage: every link adds +8% for 4 seconds, up to +40%.
5. Pick your target by element. Win +25% damage, lose -15%.
guide.soulland.section.2:
The first time you join the world you pick the language, then the Awakening Ceremony opens.
You choose your martial soul yourself. There is no draw and no lottery.

The natural order:
1. Kill soul beasts for cultivation XP.
2. Absorb the spirit rings they drop.
3. Confirm risky absorptions with Shift.
4. Build your skill loadout in the Soul Card, tab SKILLS.
5. Run the breakthrough ceremony to climb a rank.
guide.soulland.section.3:
Every martial soul has 4 skills that open at spirit ring 1, 3, 5 and 7.

Five button slots (R G F V Z) can be filled freely. Open the Soul Card with J, go to the SKILLS tab, then click a skill to place it.
Click a filled slot to empty it and fall back to the default order.

Each skill has its own effect shape: ball, line, cone, ring, disc, pillar or storm.
guide.soulland.section.4:
Spirit rings come from soul beasts according to their age: 100 years, 1,000 years, 10,000 years, 100,000 years and the gold tier of 1,000,000 years.
The gold tier falls from the Ender Dragon and sometimes from the Warden.

RISK: every ring has a safe level. Absorbing above that level can fail: the ring shatters and you take backlash. Hold Shift to confirm the risky absorption.
MUTATION: a successful absorption has a 1% chance to mutate the ring, raising its effective age one grade and giving a permanent stat bonus.

Press X to burst your rings: the whole energy is released at once, radius and damage follow the number of rings.
guide.soulland.section.5:
Cultivation runs from level 1 to 120 and fourteen ranks, from Spirit Scholar to God.
Every rank boundary is a gate.

A gate cannot be crossed with XP alone. Run the breakthrough ceremony: hold C, meditate 3 seconds, and spend 1 Soul Essence.
Your foundation decides the outcome. It builds while you meditate: at 20 you may attempt the ceremony, at 100 you always succeed. A failed ceremony costs 25 foundation points.

Plain meditation (hold C) restores spirit power and adds XP. Moving breaks the meditation.
guide.soulland.section.6:
A sect gives a passive bonus that always applies and never hurts. Pick one through the SECT tab on the Soul Card, or click a sect medallion directly.

Tang Sect: +20% cultivation XP.
Shrek Sect: +12% damage.
Star Luo Sect: +10% movement speed and +10% max health.
Seven Treasure Sect: +20% max health and +25% healing.
guide.soulland.section.7:
Soul chain: every skill that lands adds one link. The chain lasts 4 seconds, each link adds 8% damage to the next skill, up to 5 links (+40%).

Element counter: a soul beast name carries its element. +25% damage when your element wins, -15% when it loses.

Blood burn (B): trade 25 HP for 30 Spirit Power, 8 seconds of +50% damage. Not allowed below 35 HP.

Bosses: Elder Guardian 120 HP, Wither 600 HP, Warden 800 HP, Ender Dragon 1000 HP as the final boss.
guide.soulland.tip.1: Every number on this screen is read from your own state, so it always matches the world.
guide.soulland.tip.2: Your martial soul never changes by itself. Only Creative mode can replace it.
guide.soulland.tip.3: Skill loadouts are free. Rearrange them as often as you like.
guide.soulland.tip.4: Absorbing above the safe level is a gamble. The tooltip always shows your current risk.
guide.soulland.tip.5: The breakthrough ceremony needs 3 seconds of still meditation and 1 Soul Essence. Moving restarts the timer.
guide.soulland.tip.6: You can switch sects at any time, so try the one that fits how you play.
guide.soulland.tip.7: The soul chain is the cheapest way to raise damage. Line your skills up in order.
